description: Search the Agent Connectors directory. Returns matching listings from the public catalogue. At most 25 matches. This does not run or test those servers.

category.description: Category slug, such as search or data. At most 80 characters.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults to 20. Cannot exceed 25.

query.description: Words to match against the name, slug, or description. Empty matches every listing in the category. At most 200 characters.

name: search_tools
